title: GTA 6's full 34-track album leaks early 🎶
subject: gta6
description:
Which artist are you most excited to hear in GTA 6? 👇

The full 34-track tracklist of GTA VI: The Album, made by Rockstar Games and Atlantic Records, leaked on November 14, 2026 after a vinyl copy was reportedly sold early. Sources confirmed it to Rolling Stone, but Rockstar has not officially announced it. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: NME (Nov 15, 2026), Complex (Nov 15, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 15, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6's full soundtrack album has leaked.
A record store reportedly sold a vinyl copy early, and photos of the 34-track sleeve spread online on November 14.
Sources told Rolling Stone the list is real. Rockstar hasn't announced it yet.
New names include Dua Lipa, Jennie, Zara Larsson and Keith Richards, plus a Lana Del Rey song that sat unreleased for over a decade.
It launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a Rockstar music festival in Miami on November 21.
